change.summary: Extend the one-block AVX-512VL high encoder to T=8 and to one-coordinate message shortening and parity puncturing at T in {8,16,32,64}. The final shortened source is supplied as mathematical zero without a staging copy; punctured final parity is evaluated into scratch so arithmetic and wire order remain unchanged.
change.portable_isa_note: An initial seven-argument callback caused GCC to emit forbidden kmovw in the AVX-512VL member. Packing the internal shortened-input bit into the existing side argument restored the six-register call shape; the portable-ISA gate then passed and the packed contract is covered by startup KATs.

execution_eligibility.explicit_avx512: legacy-high GF8, T in {8,16,32,64}, K in {T-1,T}, R in {T-1,T}, dense full output, bytes > 1024
execution_eligibility.auto_new_shortened: K=63,R=64, aligned bytes in [2048,65536]; Leopard1 has no legal R>K comparison, so this interval is supported only by the same-source AVX2 gate
execution_eligibility.auto_new_punctured: T=64, R=63, K in {63,64}, exactly 65536 aligned bytes
auto_rejected: T=16 and T=32 shortened or punctured neighbors
execution_eligibility.unchanged_existing_auto: exact balanced K=R=T gates for T in {16,32,64}

same_source_avx2_gate.method: three independent ABBA rounds per cell; child estimator is the median of 9 samples; warmup 3; reuse 256 below 64KiB and 32 at 64KiB; CPU14 pinned; sibling CPU30 required zero non-idle jiffies for every ABBA unit
same_source_avx2_gate.interpretation: The coarse kernel is consistently faster than Leopard2's portable AVX2 kernel in these prioritized shapes. This is necessary but not sufficient for AUTO promotion because Leopard1 remains the primary end-to-end comparison.

exact_main_gate.method: independently linked exact-main and clean production Leopard2 artifacts; three ABBA rounds; six constituent pairs; median of 9 samples; warmup 3; reuse 128 at 2/4KiB and 32 at 64KiB; every accepted campaign recorded zero non-idle sibling jiffies and passed source/build/digest replay verification

discarded_campaign.reason: The original combined 10-cell campaign accumulated seven non-idle sibling jiffies. Its failure bundle verifies as diagnostics but is explicitly excluded from every result above.

unpromoted_screened_neighbors.reason: Correctness and directional saturated screens completed, but no zero-sibling exact-main gate was run after the prioritized T=64/T=8 matrix. They remain explicit-AVX512-only candidates.

correctness.cases: All 13 K/R boundary cases at 2048,2049,4096,4097,65536,65537 bytes across scalar, SSSE3, AVX2, AVX512, and AUTO; aligned R<=K outputs also matched exact Leopard1.
correctness.direct_oracle: All 13 cases executed 2049 bytes through explicit AVX512 and matched an independently constructed direct systematic generator matrix over the first and last 65 bytes of every parity shard.
correctness.partial_output: Every case retained the sparse schedule and did not enter the dense callback.
correctness.concurrency: Four simultaneous K=63,R=63,4097-byte executions shared one immutable codec and matched the reference.
correctness.startup_kat: T in {8,16,32,64}, exact and final-source-shortened, unaligned 65-byte guarded buffers; the shortened source pointer is null to prove it is not read.
correctness.tails: All candidate byte tails and deliberately unaligned buffers matched mature backends; AUTO remains aligned-only.
correctness.release_deterministic_suite: 95/95 effective pass with fuzz/lab campaigns excluded; 94 passed on the first run and the Visual Studio contract test passed after initializing the worktree's pinned sse2neon submodule.
correctness.release_focused: auto encode backend, direct encode, and portable ISA passed
correctness.fuzzing: No broad fuzz campaign was run; deterministic differential and sanitizer gates were prioritized for this arithmetic optimization.
